description: Two-panel comparison image. Top: a screenshot of a video styled as an MSNBC LIVE broadcast with a BREAKING NEWS chyron reading 'Curfews imposed across U.S. as protesters hit the streets', showing an aerial view of a city; a hand-drawn red circle highlights the corner logo area, where small watermark text reads 'BAD SCOOTER NOT REAL', indicating the clip is a parody rather than a real MSNBC broadcast. Bottom: a matching aerial film still of the Philadelphia skyline with smoke plumes and helicopters, consistent with a disaster-movie scene (resembling footage from the film World War Z), offered as the source of the fake broadcast imagery.
text: BREAKING NEWS. CURFEWS IMPOSED ACROSS U.S. AS PROTESTERS HIT THE STREETS. 46.6K views. 0:02 / 0:08. LIVE. BAD SCOOTER NOT REAL. MSNBC. 6:01 PM MT.
flags: The MSNBC broadcast is a parody — the watermark itself says 'BAD SCOOTER NOT REAL'; it is not a real MSNBC segment.
Movie-source identification (World War Z / Philadelphia) is inferred from the skyline and scene, not stated in the image.
